user.title: Connect to Koha
user.description: Enter your library's Koha OPAC URL and login credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the library server

renew_loan.name: Renew loan
renew_loan.description: Renews a single borrowed item via the library OPAC. This consumes one of the allowed renewals for that item.

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: Barcode of the item to renew (exact match). Either this or title is required.

title.name: Title
title.description: Part of the item title to renew (case-insensitive). Used when no barcode is given.

config_entry_id.name: Library
config_entry_id.description: Which configured library to use. Optional if only one is set up.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of this integration, used to pick the library when several are configured.
